evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Missing entirely. Call opens directly into pricing discussion without time-box framing or waiting for confirmation.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep launches into explanation of pricing and perks without asking customer's concerns or what they want answered.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For a typical 2200. Square footage home it usually takes around seven to nine hours with four movers and two truck but based on the items I saw on the virtual walkthrough moving from a one story house to a one story house with 45 minutes drive between location. I will estimate this move to take around seven to eight hours with two movers and one truck. And it will be good to budget around $1,449 to $1,641.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: We charge $192 per hour for two movers and one truck... Everything is included in this hourly rate, like the fuel and truck taxes, insurance, all wrap pads and bans... there's only one thing outside of the hourly rate, which is a one time travel fee of $105... there are no hidden fees of any type... We have a minimum of two and a half hours once we go over the minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: we have no worries. Damage coverage, we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair replace or reimburse for any accidental damages — missing the explicit no-deductible/no-fine-print framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: Not asked at all. Rep moves directly to the ask without checking if the estimate feels fair to the customer.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: And would you like our help with your move this Wednesday?
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Confirmed: date (Wednesday Sept 30), phone (813-300-9438), arrival window (9:00 AM to 9:30 AM), addresses (pickup 133 Senderra Crossing Levern TX 78121, delivery 2917 Bent Three Drive Shirts TX 78154). Missing: crew size confirmation, no notes left for crew about customer concerns.

top_strength: Nicole recovered gracefully when Timothy corrected the story count mid-pitch, immediately recalculated the estimate with a 30-minute buffer for stairs, and repriced without hesitation—demonstrating flexibility and customer attentiveness in real time.
coaching_note: Open with the time-box and quid pro quo framing before diving into pricing; never skip asking 'What are your biggest concerns?' before probing logistics—this call had no discovery of customer needs, only discovery of the home itself.
